houses.name: Apollo / Torsten Sløk
houses.title: Why Weak Payrolls Are No Longer Weak
houses.quote: Breakeven job growth has collapsed from 200,000 per month to close to zero today, driven b
quotes: Breakeven job growth has collapsed from 200,000 per month to close to zero today, driven by a sharp drop in immigration shrinking labor force growth and continued baby boomer retirements pulling down participation.

That means the consensus expectation of 90,000 jobs created in September is not a soft print but a solid one, comfortably above breakeven and consistent with a strong economy and a falling unemployment rate.

Equities are out. Goldman Sachs AM, Citi, JPMorgan AM stay risk-on.
The long end is in. A house that will not own it is a challenge, not a match.

closest.name: Citi
closest.clause: 4 of the five match. The card is still their note, not our score.

scorecard.falsifier: A cool inflation print that kills the next hike while stocks and the long end bid together — or a further jump in long yields that takes earnings with it.
